items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador (conforme previsto no Regulamento da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Competidores baianos terão preferência para receber prêmios nos eventos. Caso não tenham três competidores baianos com resultados válidos em um evento, outros competidores poderão receber prêmios, respeitada a preferência dos competidores da Bahia. --------------------------------------------------------------- Registration is open to all, of all nationalities. Aiming at the smooth running of the competition, when registering, you also make yourself available to help as a judge or scrambler (as stated in the WCA Regulations). This is a way for the competition to become sustainable, and the tasks are shared between all competitors, not becoming a heavy load just for a few. Competitors from Bahia will have a preference for receiving prizes in the events. If there aren't three competitors from Bahia with valid results in an event, other competitors will be eligible to receive prizes, respecting the preference of competitors from Bahia.

items.information: **English:** CubingAT is happy to announce the first official WCA competition in Salzburg, the Salzburg Open 2020. Fortunately, we found a very strong, dynamic and cool partner (HTBLuVA Salzburg), that finally gave us the possibility to solve some cubes in Salzburg. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. All guests are welcome, but to maintain the security, we would like you to let us know you’re coming. Simply write us your name to this e-mail address: competitions@cubing.at. Alternatively, if you accompany a competitor, they can write your name in the comment of their registration. ___ **Deutsch:** Wir von CubingAT freuen uns sehr euch in der HTBLuVA Salzburg, bei den ersten Salzburg Open 2020 begrüßen zu können. Dank der hervorragenden Zusammenarbeit mit dem routinierten, dynamischen und vor allem aufgeschlossenen Team der HTBLuVA, dürfen wir Speedcuber auch endlich mal in Salzburg Würfel (schnell) lösen. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Alle Gäste sind selbstverständlich gerne willkommen, jedoch würden wir euch aus Sicherheitsgründen bitten, uns ein kurzes Mail mit eurem Namen unter der E-Mail competitions@cubing.at zukommen zu lassen. Oder, falls Ihr einen Teilnehmer begleitet, kann Euer Name bei dessen Anmeldung im Kommentarfeld vermerkt werden. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0FJIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--46f5e03d373ccc1422360774454c53cb532739d2/latest%20medium%20def.png, height=3.5cm)

items.information: Español: La competencia Montevideo Palace 2019 será la tercera edición que se llevará acabo en este local. Leer el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes. Ésta competencia esta abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad, a nuevos y viejos competidores y sin importar los tiempos de resolución. Los acompañantes de los competidores no tiene que pagar ningún tipo de entrada ni inscripción. Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento, de acuerdo al artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. Por favor tengan también en cuenta los artículos [3a](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#3a) y [3a1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#3a1). English: The Montevideo Palace 2019 competition will be the third edition that will take place in this venue. Read the [regulations of the WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid possible issues. This competition is open to competitors of any nationality. Guests do not have to pay any type of entry or registration. Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with article [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the regulation. Please also take into account articles [3a](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#3a) and [3a1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#3a1).

items.information: **ESPAÑOL** Nuevamente el Palacio de la Juventud y la Municipalidad de Los Olivos nos brindarán su apoyo para llevar a cabo este torneo de speedsolving. Los resultados de este torneo ingresarán a la base de datos y al ranking de la WCA, y quienes participen por primera vez adquirirán un perfil oficial. Por esa razón, todos los competidores deben conocer el reglamento de la WCA. Cada competidor debe elegir los eventos en los que se va a inscribir cuidadosamente luego de revisar la [pestaña “Horario" (Schedule)](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PalaciodelCubo2019#competition-schedule). Prestar atención a los formatos de cada ronda y a sus respectivos cortes y límites detallados en la [pestaña “Categorías” (Events)](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PalaciodelCubo2019#competition-events). Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID. **ENGLISH** Once again Palacio de la Juventud and Municipalidad de Los Olivos are supporting another speedsolving competition. The results of this competition will be listed on the WCA world rankings and new competitors will get an official WCA profile. For that reason, each competitor must be familiar with and understand the WCA Regulations before the competition. Each competitor must carefully choose the events in which he/she will participate after having seen the [Schedule tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PalaciodelCubo2019#competition-schedule). Please pay attention to the formats of each round and its respective time limits and cutoffs detailed at the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PalaciodelCubo2019#competition-events). It is important to carefully write your name, birth date, and other information properly. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted. If this is your second competition, you must have already claimed your WCA ID.

items.information: Vous n'êtes pas obligé d'arriver au moment de l'enregistrement, nous vous accepterons sans aucun problème si vous arrivez dans la journée. Essayez simplement d'être là au moins 30 minutes avant votre première épreuve. Une pièce d'identité vous sera demandée si c'est votre première compétition. **Merci de nous prévenir par e-mail si finalement vous ne pouvez pas participer à la compétition.** **REPAS** : Les samedi soir et dimanche soir, nous vous proposons un repas collectif et des jeux, sur le lieu de la compétition. Samedi soir, pour 10€ : * Des diots (saucisse de porc Savoyarde) et des crozets (une alternative végétarienne/végétalienne devrait être disponible, merci de nous le préciser) * Un dessert, incluant des gourdes de compote de pomme ou des fruits, un yaourt et peut-être un gateau Dimanche soir pour 15€ : * Une grande pizza (au choix, commande le jour J) * Un dessert, comme le samedi **LASER GAME** : Le samedi soir, nous allons au Laser Game ensemble, nous arrangerons les voitures avec les personnes présentes. Nous avons la grande salle, de 21h50 à minuit pour 2 parties de 45 minutes. Vous pouvez participer aux deux pour 28€ (à régler au Laser Game) ou une pour 15€. Merci de préciser dans la section "Commentaire" de votre inscription si vous comptez venir, et si vous êtes accompagnés, car il y a un nombre limité de places ! --- You are not obliged to be here at registration time, we will accept you if you come during the day. Try to be here at least 30 minutes before your first event. We'll ask for an ID if it's your first competition. **Please send us an email if you cannot participate after all.** **DINNERS**: On Saturday and Sunday evening, we propose a dinner all together, and games, at the competition venue. Saturday evening for 10€: * "Diots" (Savoyarde pork saussage) et "crozets" (a bit like pasta) (a vegetarian/vegan alternative should be availble, please ask us) * A dessert, including an apple jam or fruits, a yogurt and maybe a cake Sunday evening for 15€: * A big pizza (to be chosen on the day) * A dessert, like on Saturday **LASER GAME**: On saturday night we will go to play Laser Game together, we'll arrange shuttles with the cars available. We will have the main room from 21h50 to midnight for two 45 minute games. You can play in both for 28€ (to pay at the Laser Game) or one for 15€. Please mention in the "Comment" section of your registration to the competition if you're coming and if you are alone or with guests. There are limited spots!

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.information: This will be the second Copper Country Cubing (Michigan Technological University) competition, in Michigan's great Upper Peninsula. The Memorial Union Building (MUB) is located between the middle and west end of the Michigan Tech campus. Check the schedule to see if the events at that time will be in the second floor ballroom, first floor alumni lounge, or ground floor commons. We are excited to be bringing all 18 official WCA events to the area, which doesn't get many competitions. The first CCC competition had only 8 events and 23 competitors, so this time we're making it bigger and better! Friday is reserved for big BLD and feet, so you can arrive just for Saturday and Sunday if you aren't interested in that subset of events.

items.name: UK Championship 2019
items.information: Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs above. **Qualification Requirements**: If you do not meet the qualification requirements in competition *before* 11 October 2019, you will not be eligible to compete in those events. Please see the [Qualification tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UKChampionship2019#9139-qualification) to see all times required. **Final Round Advancements**: For all events with more than one round we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 3x3x3 with Feet - 4 UK competitors; 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, 5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 - 6 UK competitors; 3x3x3 Cube - 8 UK competitors. **Please Note**: As this is the UK Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete.

items.information: **Português** O KubeKids é o 10º Campeonato Oficial do Espírito Santo. It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition site 30 minutes before the modality that will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it; - At the time of the awards, at the end of Sunday, we will draw some cubes for the competitors. Only win who is present and no one can win twice; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Try to have a lot of fun!

items.information: **ESPAÑOL** Navojoa, Sonora mejor conocida como La Perla del Mayo, es una bonita ciudad ubicada en el Sur de Sonora, rodeada de Sierra, Mar y Desierto. La tribu Mayo habita el sur de Sonora desde hace cientos de años, entre sus tradiciones mas destacadas podemos mencionar la danza del venado que es conocida a nivel internacional. La competencia del **Open del Mayo 2019** se desarrollara en el **CAS del Instituto Tecnologico de Sonora** principal universidad de la region, que cuenta con comodas instalaciones que permitiran a los participantes dar sus mejores tiempos. A menos de una hora de Navojoa se encuentra la playa de Huatabampito, El pueblo magico de Alamos y una gran variedad de atracciones turisticas de tipo rural. **INGLES** Navojoa, Sonora better known as the Pearl of May, is a beautiful city located in the South of Sonora, surrounded by Sierra, Sea and Desert. The Mayo tribe inhabits southern Sonora for hundreds of years, among its most outstanding traditions we can mention the deer dance that is known internationally. The competition del **Open del Mayo 2019** will be held at the **CAS of the Instituto Tecnologico de Sonora**, the main university in the region, which has comfortable facilities that will allow participants to give their best times. Less than an hour from Navojoa is the beach of Huatabampito, the magical town of Alamos and a wide variety of tourist attractions of a rural type. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbEVCIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--002a6631cf7fd8fb5b95574a60b59d2f48be6794/Display%20rubik%20del%20mayo.jpg2.jpg)

items.information: (HR) Croatian Nationals 2019 je trinaesto natjecanje po redu koje se održava u Hrvatskoj od 2011. godine. Bilo tko može sudjelovati, bez obzira na nacionalnost i starost, no svatko mora biti upoznat s WCA Pravilnikom. Natjecanje je pod organizacijom Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Kotizacija pokriva trošak organizacije i najma prostora. Mogući višak kotizacije ide u svrhu razvitka Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Članovi Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska ostvaruju 25% popusta na kotizaciju. Također, natjecanje je priznato kao Nacionalno Prvenstvo te će se dijeliti nagrade za najbolja 3 Hrvata u svim disciplinama. -------------- (EN) Croatian Nationals 2019 is the 13th speedcubing competition being held in Croatia since 2011. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations. This competition is being organized by the Speedcubing Association Croatia. Registration fee covers the cost of the organization and venue rental. Any extra money goes directly to support Speedcubing Association Croatia. Members of Speedcubing Association Croatia have 25% discount on the registration fee. This competition is also recognized as Croatian National Championship and top 3 Croatians in all events will be additionally awarded, alongside regular podiums.

items.name: SCS1 Almaty Open Air 2019
items.information: Летние соревнования будут проводиться на открытом воздухе на территории жилого комплекса возле Школы спидкубинга. Будут расставлены шатры защищающие участников от солнца и дождя. На соревнования необходимо взять с собой солнцезащитный крем и головоломки, которые вы будете собирать. На территории есть детская площадка и футбольное поле, где можно будет поиграть (мячи не предоставляем). Официальная церемония открытия состоится 20 июля 2019 года в 10:15. За участие всем будут выданы крутые памятные медали, а за призовые места во всех дисциплинах предусмотрены призы и медали! Summer competitions will be held outdoors in a residential complex near the School of speedcubing. Tents will be placed to protect participants from the sun and rain. Please take with you sunscreen and puzzles that you are going to solve. Onsite there is a children playground and a football field where you can play (balls are not provided) The official opening ceremony will take place on 20 July 2019 at 10:15. For participation everyone will be given a cool commemorative medals and for taking a podium of every event there are prizes and medals!

items.name: Oceania 10th Anniversary 2019

venue.name: [Wellington College](https://www.wellington-college.school.nz/facility-hire)
venue.address: 15 Dufferin St, Mount Victoria, Wellington 6021, New Zealand

items.information: Following the first competition in Oceania (New Zealand Championships 2009), speedcubing exploded in popularity across the continent. Now, ten years later, we're holding a competition to celebrate the growth of the community, and everything we've achieved over that period. Oceania 10th Anniversary 2019 returns to Wellington, the site of that first competition, and marks almost exactly ten years since then. Additionally, this is the first competition of the "Cubing Down Under Tour" - a tightly scheduled series of competitions across Oceania, leading up to WCA World Championship 2019, in Melbourne. This should build hype for the World Championship, and, (especially for foreign competitors) provide an excellent opportunity to experience more of the continent. For more information, visit the [travel page](https://wc2019.speedcubing.org.au/en/travel) of the World Championship website.

items.information: **ESPAÑOL** Este es el primer torneo patrocinado por y realizado con la ayuda de Black Horse Toys. Los resultados de este torneo ingresarán a la base de datos y al ranking de la WCA, y quienes participen por primera vez adquirirán un perfil oficial. Por esa razón, todos los competidores deben conocer el reglamento de la WCA. REGISTRO: El registro se considera completo cuando se ha completado el registro electrónico y se ha realizado el pago (precio y métodos de pago explicados en la sección de requisitos de registro). Cada competidor debe elegir los eventos en los que se va a inscribir cuidadosamente luego de revisar la pestaña “Horario" (Schedule). Prestar atención a los formatos de cada ronda y a sus respectivos cortes y límites detallados en la pestaña “Categorías” (Events). Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID. *Los competidores que vengan de fuera de Lima deberán comunicarse y coordinar la forma de pago directamente con el organizador El registro permanecerá abierto hasta el viernes 31 de mayo o hasta que se alcance el límite de competidores. **ENGLISH** This is the first competition sponsored by Black Horse Toys store. The results of this competition will be listed on the WCA world rankings and new competitors will get an official WCA profile. For that reason, each competitor must be familiar with and understand the WCA Regulations before the competition. REGISTRATION: A register is considered complete when electronic registration has been completed and payment has been made (registration fees and payment methods are detailed at Registration requirements section). Each competitor must carefully choose the events in which he/she will participate after having seen the Schedule tab. Please pay attention to the formats of each round and its respective time limits and cutoffs detailed at the Events tab. It is important to carefully write your name, birth date, and other information properly. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted. If this is your second competition, you must have already claimed your WCA ID. *Competitors who come from outside Lima will have to contact the organizer in order to coordinate the payment method. Registration will stay opened till May 31 or till competitor limit is reached.

items.information: **UPDATE** (March 9): The competition has reached the 60-competitor limit, and a number of people now have registrations on the waiting list. Registration has now been closed. In the event of any cancellation, we will accept people from the waiting list in the order in which they have paid the registration fee. STMHS is holding its first WCA competition in May! This competition is planned to help lower the costs of graduation caps and gowns for seniors in STMHS and bring some love to Connecticut cubing. (And then some!) The events consist of some NxNxN puzzles (2x2 up to 5x5, including 3x3 Blindfolded) as well as more unorthodox puzzles (Skewb, Square-1, Pyraminx). 2x2 and 3x3 will have two rounds while the rest of the events will only have one round. Guests are welcome, though it will be appreciated to inform us on how many each competitor will plan on having with them on their registration forms. To the right of the venue is New London High School which has a free parking lot, though its capacity becoming full throughout the day is unknown.

items.information: You’ve asked. We’ve said yes! Speedcubing is AGAIN coming to the township of Langley! Similar to last year, we look forward to a full house of 90 competitive cubers, this time on SATURDAY MAY 4th, 2019. The lunch and snack concession is back and CAD or USD **CASH** is required at the competition for those wishing to eat on site here. **Calling for your volunteer help**. Those previously experienced as scramblers, judges and runners willing to gift some of their time are asked to e-mail [Lindy](mailto:lindy@flefc.org) to say that **of course** you're in! Volunteering is fun, engages you fully in the day and, with plenty of help, keeps the competition events moving along in a timely manner. A judging tutorial will be provided just prior to the start of the day. Anyone who volunteers- yes, parents, too- are eligible to put their name in our draw for little thank you prizes! See you all there and we appreciate you emailing in to volunteer a portion of your day.

Las escuelas están cerradas por el día y se ha ordenado a los trabajadores que se queden en casa.** **Como hay un concurso programado para este fin de semana en Caracas, nos gustaría anunciar que existe la posibilidad de que [Cubearte Caracas 2019] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubearteCaracas2019) sea cancelado. Los competidores que se hayan inscrito recibirán un correo electrónico sobre este asunto en breve.** **Nos gustaría extender nuestras condolencias a Enrymar Cisneros (Candidato Delegado de WCA - Venezuela) y amigos en Venezuela. Se publicará una actualización sobre este asunto tan pronto como sea posible.** ***WCA Competition Announcement Team*** ______ The competition will be held at Escuela Tecnica de Artes Visuales Cristobal Rojas Main Hall, on Caracas, Capital District. **[URGENT] We are deeply saddened to learn that Venezuela has been under a major power outage since Thursday evening local time. Schools are closed for the day and workers have been ordered to stay at home.** **As there is a competition scheduled to be held in Caracas this weekend, we would like to announce that there is a possibility [Cubearte Caracas 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubearteCaracas2019) will be cancelled. Competitors that have registered will be emailed about this matter shortly.** **We would like to extend our condolences to Enrymar Cisneros(WCA Candidate Delegate - Venezuela) and friends in Venezuela. An update regarding this matter will be posted as soon as possible.** ***WCA Competition Announcement Team***
